title: Cleopatra Lived Closer to Us Than to the Pyramids

segments.text: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
The Great Pyramid was already about 2,500 years old when she was born.
To Cleopatra, the pyramids were ancient history too.
She ruled as Egypt's last active pharaoh.
So when you picture ancient Egypt, she came at the very end.
Closer to us than to the pyramids she stood beside.
Follow for history they never taught you.

description: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the Great Pyramid's construction. Follow for daily history!
